channel.description: Latest articles from The Brantford Expositor (brantfordexpositor.ca)

item.title: Haldimand homeowners face 3.74% tax hike this year
item.description: Haldimand council approved a $97.3-million operating budget for 2026, with the increase adding roughly $145 to the property tax bill for the average home in the rural county.

item.title: Grand Erie Public Health issues alert after seven drug overdoses in Brantford area
item.description: Grand Erie Public Health has issued an alert after another increase in suspected opioid overdoses.

item.title: Moving forward: Brantford to hold West Brant Access route public meeting
item.description: Residents have an opportunity to learn more about Brantford's plans to solve traffic woes afflicting motorists living in West Brant.

item.title: Brantford embarking on new pilot project to reduce homelessness
item.description: A pilot project to prevent evictions and reduce homelessness in Brantford, Brant is getting a $449,943 boost from the federal government.

item.title: Six Nations community ‘devastated’ by sudden closure of only library
item.description: The only library on Six Nations of the Grand River territory was shut down without warning last week, leaving staff bewildered and throwing plans for an upcoming 60th anniversary celebration in flux.

item.title: Brantford Bulldogs come-from-behind to beat Brampton Steelheads
item.description: There isn’t a roller-coaster in the world that has more ups and downs than the Brantford Bulldogs
